about: Where a fresh install starts and what RESET goes back to, plus each slider's range. Nothing here is fixed: every value can be changed with the tuning panel (Tab), and those changes save to flight_tuning.json next to BitMiner.exe. Starting values are Clay's tuning from the sprint 2 flight test. CAMERA AIM (new in sprint 4) leans the view toward the mouse in a fight, so you can see what you aim at. MAP SIZE (new in sprint 5) is how big the Secure the Base map is, in times the combat sandbox's size each way; a change takes effect on the next new game (Backspace). TOW WEIGHT (new in sprint 10) is how heavy a rock on the lasso feels, as a share of its real weight: lower tows big rocks more easily. THROW POWER (new in sprint 10) multiplies the damage a thrown rock does; 0 makes thrown rocks harmless. WAVE GAP (new in sprint 12) multiplies the time between Secure the Base waves: lower sends them faster. WAVE SIZE (new in sprint 12) multiplies how many ships each wave has, massive waves included.
